items.summary: BTC entered the 2026 midterm vote up 20.4% over 90 days, the first positive pre-midterm window since 2010 (2014 ~−44%, 2018 −8.3%, 2022 −16.5%); a four-cycle sample is too small for a trading rule.
items.reply:
On-chain it looks like a reset, not a blow-off.
Price is sitting near the middle of the STH cost bands (+0.14 SD), way down from +1.26 in September. Agree the election sample is tiny, so I lean on cost basis.
items.sources: 短期持有者成本帶：現在 +0.14 個標準差、120 日最高 +1.26（2026-09-21）· 11/04 · Bitview（近 4 年價格÷成本的平均 ± 標準差）
items.note: 3 萬粉、剛發。態度謹慎（樣本太少），回覆順著他，補鏈上的另一面：漲上來但沒有過熱。

image.title: Price at +0.14 SD in the STH cost bands, down from +1.26

items.author: Jackyi_ld
items.name: Jackyi
items.summary: 突破 80,300、站上 20 日均線；要強勢突破 82,600 才有第二波主升浪，再看 86K 壓力，過 86K 看 97K、104K；認為目前是牛市趨勢。
items.reply:
82,600 這關我也覺得關鍵，因為好幾條線全擠在那裡。
50 日均線、近 20 天的價值區上緣（82,750）都在附近。收盤站上去，最近套牢的那段就全踩在腳下了。
你會等收盤才認，還是盤中破了就算？
items.sources: 50 日均線 81,993、近 20 天價值區上緣 82,750、POC 80,750 · 11/04 · Kraken 日線

items.reply: 同意風控擺前面，籌碼現在擠得很誇張：18% 的幣最後一次移動就在現價上下 5% 內，2018 年以來第 98.6 百分位。以前擠成這樣，接下來一個月通常不會小動。82K 的突破我也等週五到期後再認。
items.sources: 最後移動在收盤 ±5%（76,355–84,392）的籌碼 18.25%、2018 起第 98.6 百分位；高集中之後 30 天最大單向變動中位 22.7%（其他時候 15.9%）· 11/04 · Bitview；11/6 週到期最大痛點 79,000 · Deribit
items.note: 偏謹慎，順著他「風險管理優先、驗證窗口在下週」。配 11/05 網站新加的「籌碼結構與集中度」：籌碼擠在現價附近，歷史上之後一個月波動較大，支持他先顧風控。

items.author: 0xkyliekim
items.name: Kylie Kim
items.summary: Hut 8 fell 23.2% after earnings: $189.5M net income was mostly a $413.8M unrealized BTC gain, revenue $71.1M; used ~3,100 BTC to buy back $250M of stock. Watch revenue, not headline EPS.
items.reply:
The stress is in the stock, not the hash.
Miners don't look forced at all: hashrate is only down ~4% on the week and the next difficulty adjustment is expected to drop. Agree on watching revenue over the BTC mark.
items.sources: 算力 7 日均 1,028 EH/s、週 −4.28%；11/13 難度預估 −2.26% · 11/04 · mempool.space

items.author: Darkfost_Coc
items.name: Darkfost
items.summary: Seller exhaustion model (supply in profit vs monthly volatility) is back at its lowest bear market levels; historically that let bottoms form, but it does not predict recovery: demand is still missing.
items.reply: Mine's sitting near bear lows too, bottom 10% or so since 2011. Demand is what bugs me though, apparent demand still around −156K BTC over 30 days
items.sources: 賣方衰竭常數 0.2051（2011 起第 10.8 百分位；極端區 < 0.13，上次在 2026/08）；表觀需求 30 天 −156,497 顆 · 11/04 · CheckOnChain
items.note: 1.2 萬粉、3,067 瀏覽，是 CryptoQuant 的分析師，建議用引用。他的立場是「賣方累了、需求還沒來」，順著講。我們的讀值還沒回到極端區，回覆照實寫「不像 8 月那麼極端」。

image.title: Seller exhaustion constant 0.2051: 10.8th percentile since 2011

items.quote:
Seeing the same thing on my end, seller exhaustion is down near bear lows (bottom ~10% since 2011). Demand's the part that still bugs me, around −156K BTC over 30 days

items.author: raychix
items.name: raychix
items.summary: Relays Darkfost: seller exhaustion back at bear market lows; historically lines up with bottoms, but demand is still missing.
items.reply:
Some of that "missing demand" is just coins turning one year old.
Last year's buys crossing the 1-year mark added ~170K BTC in 30 days. Not all of it is fresh selling.
items.sources: 表觀需求 30 天 −156,497 顆、自己的 30 日均 −64,340；滿一年未動的幣 30 天 +17.0 萬顆 · 11/04 · CheckOnChain HODL waves
items.note: 轉述 Darkfost 的貼文，角度錯開：回需求那一半。
